In this repo (packages/core/src/assurance/rules.ts, echoed in AGENTS.md), findings/edges carry an `AssuranceGrade` of either `"verified"` or `"inferred"`:

- `verified` — used only when there is real execution evidence (e.g., a parsed CI report or a probed/executed artifact, a `test`/`ci` evidence row with a `supports` relationship). Per AGENTS.md: "`verified` only with execution evidence."
- `inferred` — used when the finding rests only on AI/rule-based reasoning without execution proof. Per AGENTS.md: "AI reasoning is always `inferred`."

Severity ceiling: the `capSeverity()` function in `packages/core/src/assurance/rules.ts` enforces that any finding graded `inferred` (i.e., a chain that never reaches the `verified` label) cannot be reported above `"medium"` severity — if the requested severity was `"critical"` or `"high"`, it is downgraded to `"medium"` (verified findings keep their original severity, including critical/high).
